name: What is the typical cost range for an outdoor kitchen in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for an outdoor kitchen in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an outdoor kitchen in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on size, materials, and features. A basic setup with a built-in grill and some counter space might start around $8,000 to $15,000. More elaborate designs incorporating advanced appliances, custom cabinetry, and extensive finishes can range from $20,000 to over $50,000. It's best to discuss your vision with a contractor for a precise estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for outdoor kitchens in Las Vegas typically range from $8,000 for basic setups to over $50,000 for elaborate designs, depending on features and materials.
